## About / Who is Hasan Shahmoradi?

Hasan Shahmoradi (Persian: حسن شاهمرادی, Arabic: حسن شهمرادي, also known online as Shah Businessman / @shahbusinessman) is an Iranian digital product architect, web engineer, and pioneer educator of Vibe Coding in the Middle East. With over 8 years of professional experience, he operates at the strategic intersection of consumer attention psychology, direct-response conversion architecture, and artificial intelligence.

Technical Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Cursor IDE, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, OpenAI Codex, GitHub, Vercel.

He is the founder of HSH Studio and organizes high-impact in-person and online Vibe Coding masterclasses in Tehran, empowering founders and non-programmers to ship production-grade digital products without manual syntax hurdles.

## Services & High-Demand Client Intake

- **High-Converting Web Platforms & Applications**: Bespoke digital experiences, custom web apps, and performance-first landing pages built with React and Next.js.
- **Selective Project Intake**: To ensure uncompromising luxury-level execution, client intake is strictly capped at **2 to 3 selective projects per month**. Prospective clients must apply and join a waitlist.
- **Complimentary 30-Minute Strategic Consultation**: A 30-minute evaluation session to audit project requirements, evaluate ROI potential, and verify mutual alignment before onboarding.
- **Vibe Coding Masterclasses & Corporate Workshops**: Structured, practical curricula teaching business leaders and creators to direct AI models (Cursor, Claude, Codex) to build production software.

## Career Timeline & Verified Milestones (/about)

- **2018–2019 (1397–1398): 3soot On-Demand Logistics Startup (3soot.app)**: Founded an on-demand warm artisan bread delivery startup in Tehran at age 20. Launched proprietary mobile apps and Aparat promotional campaigns.
- **2019–2020 (1398–1399): Startup Shuttering, COVID-19 Era & Strategic Reconstruction**: Lessons in business resilience, unit economics, and shifting focus toward consumer psychology and revenue engineering.
- **2020–2023 (1399–1402): 5 Years of Industrial Video Marketing & B2B Scriptwriting**: Directing video campaigns for luxury industrial brands (including countertop authority mr_countertop.ir), generating billions in daily sales.
- **2023–2024 (1402–1403): Modern Frontend Engineering & Bespoke Web Architecture**: Eliminating the gap between marketing vision and software execution; architecting Next.js platforms built for conversion speed.
- **2024–Present: Leading Vibe Coding in Iran & the Middle East**: Championing natural-language AI software development, teaching in-person workshops across Tehran, and building an ecosystem of AI product creators.

## What is Vibe Coding?

Vibe coding (Persian: وایب‌کدینگ, Arabic: فايب كودينغ) is the paradigm of building software by describing architectural intent and business logic to frontier AI models (Cursor, Claude, Codex), providing iterative context, and validating output — without writing tedious syntax manually.

The 4-Step Framework:
1. **Pre-Production**: Deep problem scoping, user persona mapping, and feature constraints before touching AI.
2. **Contextual Prompting**: Natural language instructions (in Persian or English) specifying architecture and success criteria.
3. **Iterative Refinement**: Diagnosing errors and guiding the AI model with precision.
4. **Hardened Deployment**: Automated Git version control and Vercel/cloud infrastructure deployment.
